symptom: Customers report that checkout orders are not completing as expected

report.summary: Checkout failures trace to payment-service calls from order-service timing out. Incident window: 6 orders stuck PAYMENT_PENDING with PAYMENT_UNAVAILABLE and HttpTimeoutException on POST payment-service:8081/payments (D18, D37). payment-service server latency max rose to 1.326s and gateway-mock /authorize max to 1.318s, with max ~10s on some points (D27, D33), and payment-service logs no errors. Gateway-mock shows no failures, so the slowness starts at gateway-mock, a DEPENDENCY_LATENCY.
